title: Nabu
tagline: Peer 2 Peer ebook publishing application. Upload your ebook to a secret link, that can be accessed only by NFT holders of the ebook copy.
description:
This project combines two main parts: 
- nft.storage application for easy creation of NFTs and uploading the cover material to the IPFS;
- submarine API from pinata is used for uploading ebooks to a dedicated gateway with the created NFT collection address that will be used for verification.

When put together, it is one place to create and distribute ebooks as NFTs. 
Lastly, it is also a marketplace to resell ebooks on a secondary market.
how_its_made:
This app uses Scaffold Eth for web3 abstractions. 
nft.storage is used for uploading ebook covers, or simply put the face of the NFT that will represent the individual book.
Pinata Submarine technology then allows us to create token-gated content. The address of the NFT is submitted to the piece of content ( the book in our case ) that will allow holders to sign in using their wallet. 
The sale of the NFTs is managed by the Scaffold Eth tab
